Copacabana and Sugarloaf Mountain are mine, / on Brazil's southeast coast, where the sun's always fine.
Brazil's famous beach city, with Christ the Redeemer, see? / Carnival's capital. That's me.
fact: City of God (2002) is set in a real Rio neighborhood, Cidade de Deus, and many of its actors came from Rio's favelas.

from: 📖 The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
name: Stockholm, Sweden
clues: A hacker with a dragon tattoo and a writer teamed up / to solve an old family mystery, then cracked it right up. / I'm built on fourteen islands joined by bridges between, / and the Nobel Prize dinner is held here, a grand scene.
ABBA's museum is here, and my old town's narrow lanes, / in Scandinavia, where the long winter reigns.
The capital of Sweden, on the Baltic Sea, see? / Built on islands. That's me.
fact: Stieg Larsson's Millennium books are set in Stockholm, where the Nobel Prize banquet is held at City Hall every December.

name: Meteora, Greece
clues: A spy climbed a cliff to a monastery's door, / on a rock tower high above the valley floor. / My monks once were hauled up in nets on a rope, / to live on my pillars, way up with their hope.
My name means 'suspended in the air,' they say, / in central Greece, where the monks still pray.
Rock pillars topped with monasteries in central Greece, see? / Meteora. That's me.
fact: In For Your Eyes Only (1981), Bond climbs to the Holy Trinity monastery at Meteora. Monks once reached some monasteries by being pulled up in nets.

name: Seaside, Florida, USA
clues: A man's whole life was a TV show, / but he lived in my town and he didn't know. / My houses are pastel, with white picket fences, / and the Gulf's turquoise beach is right past my benches.
I'm a planned beach town on Florida's Panhandle coast, / where the pastel cottages charm visitors most.
A small town on the Florida Panhandle, near Panama City, see? / Truman's Seahaven. That's me.
fact: The Truman Show was filmed in Seaside, Florida, a planned beach town started in 1981.

name: Barcelona, Spain
clues: A boy found a book in a library of lost books, / and the author's dark secret was hidden in nooks. / My church has been under construction for years, / and my wavy-roofed buildings bring artists to tears.
Gaudí built my wild buildings and park, / on Spain's Mediterranean coast, lively till dark.
Catalonia's capital, on Spain's northeast coast, see? / La Sagrada Família. That's me.
fact: The Shadow of the Wind is set in Barcelona. Gaudí's Sagrada Família has been under construction since 1882.

name: Forbidden City, Beijing, China
clues: A boy became emperor when he was just three, / and lived in my palace, where few could be free. / I've nearly a thousand buildings with roofs of gold-yellow, / and for centuries, no ordinary person could come in, fellow.
Tiananmen Square stands right at my gate, / in China's capital, where emperors sat in state.
The old imperial palace in the middle of Beijing, see? / The Forbidden City. That's me.
fact: The Last Emperor (1987) was the first Western feature film allowed to shoot inside the Forbidden City.

name: Kakadu National Park, Australia
clues: A bushman with a big knife wrestled crocs in my streams, / then went to New York and made it big, it seems. / My rock art was painted thousands of years ago, / and my wetlands are wild, where the crocodiles go.
I'm a huge national park in the Top End's wild heat, / in northern Australia, where the floodplains meet.
A national park in Australia's Northern Territory, east of Darwin, see? / Crocodile country. That's me.
fact: Crocodile Dundee (1986) was filmed in and around Kakadu National Park, which has rock art made over thousands of years.

name: Vatican City
clues: A professor raced bombs through my halls and my squares, / while cardinals voted inside, unawares. / I'm the smallest country on Earth, it is true, / with a famous painted ceiling, and Swiss Guards too.
Saint Peter's Basilica's dome is mine, / surrounded by Rome, with the Sistine Chapel's shine.
The world's smallest country, inside Rome, see? / Where the pope lives. That's me.
fact: Angels & Demons wasn't allowed to film inside the Vatican, so the crew rebuilt St. Peter's Square and the Sistine Chapel as sets.

name: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
clues: A DJ shouted 'good morning' on the radio here, / to soldiers at war, bringing jokes and some cheer. / My streets are a river of scooters and noise, / and my noodle soup stalls are a breakfast of joys.
I used to be called Saigon, near the Mekong's wide mouth, / Vietnam's biggest city, way down in the south.
Vietnam's biggest city, once Saigon, see? / In the south. That's me.
fact: Good Morning, Vietnam is based on Adrian Cronauer, a real US Armed Forces radio DJ in Saigon in 1965.

name: Preikestolen, Norway
clues: Two men fought on the edge of a cliff that's so flat, / six hundred meters straight down, imagine that. / I'm a square rock pulpit above a long fjord, / and hikers sit on my edge, and they never get bored.
My name means 'Pulpit Rock,' above the Lysefjord's blue, / in Norway's southwest, with a hike to the view.
A flat cliff above Lysefjord near Stavanger, Norway, see? / Pulpit Rock. That's me.
fact: Mission: Impossible – Fallout filmed its cliff-top finale on Preikestolen, about 600 meters above the Lysefjord.

name: Kerala, India
clues: Twin kids grew up by a river so green, / in a story of love and the things in between. / My backwaters wind through palm trees and rice, / and houseboats float by, all lazy and nice.
God's Own Country, they call me, with spices and tea, / on India's southwest coast, by the Arabian Sea.
A state in southwest India, Kochi's my port, see? / Backwaters and houseboats. That's me.
fact: Arundhati Roy's The God of Small Things is set in Ayemenem, a village in Kerala, and won the Booker Prize in 1997.

name: Kathmandu, Nepal
clues: A surgeon with broken hands traveled to me / and learned how to bend time and space, magically. / My temples have eyes painted high on their tops, / and prayer flags flutter over my streets and my shops.
I'm the gateway to Everest, in a valley up high, / in a Himalayan country where the mountains touch sky.
The capital of Nepal, see? / Doctor Strange's magic school. That's me.
fact: Doctor Strange filmed scenes on Kathmandu's streets in 2015, playing the home of the Kamar-Taj school.

name: Amalfi Coast, Italy
clues: A con man made friends with a rich young man here, / then took over his life, which was rather severe. / My towns cling to cliffs in pink, yellow and white, / and my lemons are huge, and my sea's turquoise bright.
Positano tumbles down to my shore, / in southern Italy, with limoncello galore.
A cliffside coast south of Naples, Italy, see? / Positano and Ravello. That's me.
fact: Ripley's village of 'Mongibello' is fictional, but it's based on the coast south of Naples, and the 2024 series filmed in Atrani on the Amalfi Coast.

name: Dyersville, Iowa, USA
clues: A farmer heard a voice in his tall green corn, / and he built a ballfield where ghosts would be born. / Old players walked out from the stalks to play, / and folks still come to toss balls there today.
In 2021 the big leagues came to play / by my cornfield in Iowa, a magical day.
A small farm town in eastern Iowa, see? / The Field of Dreams. That's me.
fact: The Field of Dreams diamond near Dyersville still stands, and in 2021 Major League Baseball played a real game beside it.

name: Nassau, Bahamas
clues: A spy swam with sharks in my clear, warm sea, / chasing stolen bombs hidden under me. / My waters are turquoise, my houses pastel, / and pirates once ruled here and partied as well.
Pirates like Blackbeard once ran me, they say, / on an island in the Bahamas, off Florida's way.
The capital of the Bahamas, on New Providence, see? / Cruise ships stop here. That's me.
fact: Thunderball (1965) was filmed around Nassau, and its underwater battle was one of the biggest ever filmed at the time.

name: Munich, Germany
clues: A girl stole books during a war long ago, / and hid a friend in her basement below. / Her town is near me, where the beer halls are loud, / and each fall my Oktoberfest draws a huge crowd.
Oktoberfest happens here, with pretzels and beer, / the capital of Bavaria, with the Alps near.
Germany's third-biggest city, in Bavaria, see? / Oktoberfest. That's me.
fact: The Book Thief's town of Molching is fictional, based on Olching, just outside Munich.

name: Ellis Island, New York, USA
clues: A small boy from Sicily came by boat to my door, / sick and alone, to a new country's shore. / Twelve million came through my great hall to start new, / with Lady Liberty watching them all coming through.
I'm a small island in New York's harbor bay, / where immigrants landed in the old days.
An island in New York Harbor, by the Statue of Liberty, see? / The old immigration station. That's me.
fact: About 12 million immigrants came through Ellis Island between 1892 and 1954. In The Godfather Part II, young Vito arrives there in 1901.

name: Bethlehem
clues: A couple came riding a donkey by night, / and the inns were all full, so a stable felt right. / A baby was born, and a star shone above, / and shepherds came running to see him with love.
The Church of the Nativity stands on my square, / just south of Jerusalem, with Christmas everywhere.
A town in the West Bank, south of Jerusalem, see? / Where the Christmas story began. That's me.
fact: Bethlehem's Church of the Nativity, first built in the 300s, is one of the oldest churches still in use.
